```js
// spe/evals/harness/grader.js
const PRIORITIES = new Set(["P1", "P2", "P3", "P4"]);
function normPriority(x) {
  const v = String(x ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
  return PRIORITIES.has(v) ? v : null;
}
function priorityCorrect(answer, reference) {
  const a = normPriority(answer);
  return a !== null && a === normPriority(reference);
}
// Also logged per trial, for the format question in D-r03-1:
function priorityExact(answer, reference) {
  return answer === reference;
}
```

```js
// spe/evals/harness/grader.selftest.js (added cases)
assert(priorityCorrect("P1", "P1"));         // oracle passes
assert(!priorityCorrect("", "P1"));          // empty fails
assert(!priorityCorrect("P3", "P1"));        // wrong fails
assert(priorityCorrect("p1", "P1"));         // case variant passes
assert(priorityCorrect(" P1 ", "P1"));       // whitespace passes
assert(!priorityCorrect("P5", "P5"));        // out of range fails
assert(!priorityCorrect("priority 1", "P1")); // free text fails
```
